errors.text_span: Хоризонталната ос представлява процентни стойности, етикетирана с „%“, с линейна скала, която започва от 0 и се простира до 70%, с отметки на всеки 10% (0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70).
errors.evidence: The chart does not display a visible horizontal axis with a label, scale, or tick marks. The description fabricates these details.

The description does not mention the sorting order of the bars within each category. The bars for population size are sorted in descending order of value, and the bars for district type are sorted in ascending order.
